title: The Flowing Laksa
introEn:
Singapore in motion: HDB blocks, rain trees, MRT lines and hawker tables,
all folded into the same warm everyday rhythm.
introZh:
新加坡像一碗流动的叻沙：组屋、雨树、地铁与熟食中心，
都被搅进同一种温热的日常。

title: NUS Fragments
introEn:
Corridors, laboratories, tropical greenery and quiet pauses—
small pieces of a place slowly absorbed into everyday life.
introZh:
走廊、实验室、热带绿意与片刻停顿，
拼成一些逐渐变成日常的 NUS 碎片。

title: My Fluffy Friend
introEn:
No destination this time—just familiar expressions,
small routines and the quiet comfort of having a fluffy companion nearby.
introZh:
这一次没有目的地，只有熟悉的表情、小小的日常，
以及一位毛茸茸伙伴安静的陪伴。

title: Under the Same Heat
meta:
Singapore · Kuala Lumpur · Bangkok · Chiang Mai
July 2026
introEn:
Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok and Chiang Mai—
different cities moving under the same tropical heat.
introZh:
新加坡、吉隆坡、曼谷与清迈，
在同一种热带暑气里，各自维持着不同的城市节奏。

title: Andalus
introEn:
Madrid, Andalusia, Palma and Barcelona—
a journey across Spain shaped by stone, sea,
southern light and changing cities.
introZh:
从马德里、安达卢西亚到帕尔马与巴塞罗那，
石头、海岸与南方的光串起一段不断变换的西班牙旅程。

title: Pacific Waves
introEn:
Los Angeles stretches between Pacific light,
freeways and impossible distances—
a city that always seems to be moving.
introZh:
洛杉矶铺展在太平洋的光、高速公路与漫长距离之间，
一座似乎永远处在移动中的城市。

title: Bonfire
introEn:
November in Britain: early darkness, cold air, fire,
smoke and a few nights suddenly made bright.
introZh:
英国十一月天黑得很早，
篝火、烟雾与人群却在几个夜晚里突然把寒冷的黑暗点亮。

title: 流俗地
introEn:
Penang and Ipoh through shophouses, kopitiams,
humid streets and durian season—
the ordinary pleasures that make a place memorable.
introZh:
槟城与怡保，骑楼、咖啡店、湿热街巷和榴莲季；
所谓地方，大概就藏在这些流俗而具体的快乐里。

title: Traces of Hokkien
introEn:
Across Minnan, temple roofs, old streets and everyday details
carry traces of a culture that travelled far beyond the coast.
introZh:
闽南的庙宇、老街与日常细节里，
留着一种沿海远行，却始终没有离开的文化痕迹。

title: Rome’s Northern Edge
introEn:
Newcastle, Northumberland and Hadrian’s Wall—
stone, moorland and autumn weather along the old northern frontier
of Roman Britain.
introZh:
从纽卡斯尔到诺森伯兰与哈德良长城，
荒原、石墙与秋日天气铺展在昔日罗马不列颠的北方边界。

title: 省港澳
meta:
Guangzhou · Foshan, Shenzhen · Hong Kong · Macau · Zhuhai
2024
introEn:
Guangzhou, Foshan, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Macau and Zhuhai—
cities divided by borders and water,
yet held together by the same restless delta.
introZh:
從廣州、佛山、深圳到香港、澳門與珠海，
邊界與水面分隔城市，也把它們重新連成同一片流動的珠江口。

title: 小小多山的島
introEn:
Taipei sits between rain, dense streets and surrounding hills;
beyond the basin, the island keeps folding upward.
introZh:
台北被雨、密集的街道與群山包圍；
走出盆地，這座小小多山的島仍一層層向上折起。

title: Colonial Express
introEn:
Edinburgh, New York and Chicago—
three cities of stone, grids and skylines,
connected by an improbable line across the Atlantic.
introZh:
从爱丁堡的石墙，到纽约的街网与芝加哥的天际线，
三座城市被一条横跨大西洋的想象路线串在一起。

title: De Lage Landen（低地）
introEn:
From France into Belgium and the Netherlands,
autumn flattens into canals, brick façades
and increasingly low skies.
introZh:
从法国进入比利时与荷兰，
秋天逐渐变得低平而潮湿，
运河、砖墙与低垂天空接管沿途景色。

title: Vers la Méditerranée（向地中海）
meta:
Dubai · Paris · Avignon · Nice · Monaco · Genoa · Florence · Pisa · Rome
2022
introEn:
From Dubai to Paris, then Avignon, Nice, Monaco, Genoa,
Florence, Pisa and Rome—
a journey gradually drawn toward the Mediterranean.
introZh:
从迪拜到巴黎，再经阿维尼翁、尼斯、摩纳哥、热那亚、
佛罗伦萨与比萨抵达罗马，
旅程一步步靠近地中海。

title: 新冠时期的爱情
introEn:
Years later, when I thought of London in the winter of 2021,
I would first remember masks, empty streets,
and the small warmth of two people in a city learning to keep its distance.
introZh:
多年以后，当我想起 2021 年冬天的伦敦，
最先浮现的仍是口罩、空街，
以及一座学会保持距离的城市里，两个人之间小小的温度。
